report_name: Who Gives A Crap Data Exposed in Marketing Vendor Breach

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The data breach was the result of a compromise at a third-party marketing software vendor, representing a supply chain attack against Who Gives A Crap.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: An unauthorized party exploited the trusted relationship between Who Gives A Crap and its marketing vendor to access customer data.

campaigns.name: October 2026 Who Gives A Crap Marketing Vendor Compromise
campaigns.description: An unnamed threat actor compromised a US-based marketing software provider between October 30 and November 1, 2026, to access and exfiltrate PII of Who Gives A Crap customers.

identities.name: Who Gives A Crap
identities.description: An eco-friendly toilet paper company whose customer PII (names, emails, and shipping addresses) was exposed due to a compromise at a third-party marketing software vendor.
